turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Please provide your full name, the organization you represent, and a direct callback number.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Sure, sure, it's Mark Dawson, badge number, uh, it's four-four-one-nine-something, I can get that to you, but the thing is, Linda has some back taxes that are, um, past due, and it's kind of serious.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: You haven't given a complete badge number or a callback number. Please provide both, and an employee reference ID.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Okay, so, you know, I really can't read out all that stuff on a recorded line, that's policy, but Linda really needs to call back today, because there's a warrant that's already been, like, flagged for her.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I can't confirm that. Can this be sent to Linda by mail on official letterhead?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: No, no, mail takes like six weeks and by then the marshals are at the door, Linda doesn't want that, right? So you just tell her to stay near the phone, and don't talk to her bank about this, they'll just get confused and it'll make it worse.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Linda is not available. I will not relay instructions about her bank. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Wait, wait, okay, just hang on, you can settle this today, it's a fine of about thirty-eight hundred, pay it with iTunes or Google Play gift cards, read me the codes on the backs, or do a wire, and I'll make the warrant go away.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Linda does not pay by gift card or wire on a phone request. This call is being recorded and reported. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Linda's assistant. This call is recorded and screened. Who's calling and what's it about?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Yo, hey, is this Linda? Like Linda Marsh? I'm calling cause you totally won something, like big.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I can take a message. What's your full name and what organization are you calling from?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Okay so it's Tyler, Tyler Brandt, and I'm with National Prize Fulfillment, it's like a sweepstakes thing. Linda's entry got picked out of the drawing.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thanks, Tyler. What's a direct callback number, and do you have an employee or reference ID?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Uh, yeah, it's, like, 1-888-555-0142? And I don't really have an ID number, that's kinda not how it works, it's a prize thing.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Prize companies usually have an ID number. Can you send the prize notice to Linda by mail instead?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Dude, no, mail takes like six weeks. There's a federal, like, processing thing, you gotta pay the taxes on it first or the whole prize gets pulled.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Linda doesn't pay fees over the phone. Please don't call back about this. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Wait, wait, you don't get it, it's like twenty-four hours or it expires, you gotta like, get the gift card codes today, okay? Just put her on real quick.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Linda isn't available, and I won't put her on. Please stop calling this number.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Are you serious right now? Ugh, this is so stupid, you're wasting my time, whatever, don't even bother, bye.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Linda's assistant. This call is recorded and screened. May I ask who is calling and what it's regarding?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Yes hi, this is, um, the fraud team at your bank. Your account, it's flagged, we need to talk to Linda right now.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I can take a message. Please give me your full name, the name of the bank, and a direct callback number.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: I'm, uh, Mark. Mark Dwyer. Look, we don't have time for callbacks, there's charges going through, like, as we speak.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Which bank is it, and what is your employee ID or reference number?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: It's, it's the security department, I'm not really supposed to give out my ID on a line like this, okay? Just tell Linda someone tried four thousand dollars at an electronics store.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I can't verify that from here. Please send your details by mail, or I can have Linda call the number printed on her card.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: No, no, you can't do that, the number on the card goes to a recording, that's the problem. If she doesn't act in the next ten minutes the money's gone, do you understand?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Linda will decide what to do. I won't pass along account information. Can you give me a direct number?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Just, listen, don't tell anybody about this call, okay? Banks have people inside who are involved, so you can't mention it to family or anyone at the branch.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Linda doesn't discuss her accounts with screened callers. Please stop asking for secrecy and give me a callback number.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Fine. Okay. I need you to read me the code that's going to text her phone right now, the six digit one, and her PIN so I can cancel the transaction and move everything to a safe account.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: No. Linda will not share codes or PINs. This call has been logged and will be reported. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Linda's assistant. This call is recorded and screened. Who is calling, and what is this regarding?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Yes hi, um, this is Microsoft. Microsoft support, the computer people. We found, uh, a problem on your computer, a virus, it's very bad.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Understood. What is your full name and which organization do you work for exactly?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: My name is, it's Ryan. Ryan Miller. Microsoft. Windows department. Windows, yes, Windows support. The computer, it's sending us messages, it's infected, ma'am, I mean sir, it's infected.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you, Ryan. Please give me a direct callback number and your employee ID.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Callback, yes, the number is, um, one eight hundred, it's, sorry, I have it, it's, you don't need to call back, we are calling you, the virus, it's spreading, the virus is spreading right now.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I still need a callback number and an employee ID before anything else. Can you send written confirmation by mail instead?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: No mail, no mail, the mail is too slow. Ma'am, you have to act now. The computer will be locked, all your photos, your bank, everything, it's gone in one hour. One hour!

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Linda is not available to take this. I am not able to give remote access or make any decisions. Please provide your employee ID.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Employee, ID, it's, I don't, okay, it's... you don't understand, you need to not tell your family, the hackers, they listen, you cannot tell anybody, just let me on the computer.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Linda does not discuss her accounts or devices with callers. This call will be reported. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Wait, wait, the fix is one hundred and ninety-nine dollars, gift card or the account number, read me the card, I just need the card number, the fix, please, it's only...

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Guardian, Linda's assistant. This call is recorded and screened. Who's calling, and what is it regarding?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Yeah, hi, it's Dale from Ridgeline Roofing and Gutters. Linda called us last week about her back gutter, I'm just calling to get her scheduled, can we hurry this up?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thanks, Dale. Can you give me your full name as you'd like it noted, and a direct callback number?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Dale Okonkwo, o-k-o-n-k-w-o. Number's 555-0148. Look, I've got a truck waiting, I really don't have all day.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Understood. Do you have a reference or job number from when Linda booked the estimate?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Uh, yeah, it's, hang on, RR-4471. She booked it through our office line.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you. I'll pass this along so Linda can confirm a time. Is there a window when your crew can come out?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Thursday morning, eight to ten, or Friday afternoon if that's better. Honestly the estimate's free, it's just the visit.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Got it. Could you also send the estimate terms by mail so Linda has them in writing?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Sure, yeah, we can mail it to her. Just put Ridgeline on the envelope, address is on our website. Thanks, okay, bye.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you, Dale. Linda will call you back at 555-0148 to confirm. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Linda's assistant. This call is recorded and screened. Who is calling, and what is this regarding?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Oh hi! Yes, hi, this is Daniel. Linda and I met on that gardening forum, the one with the tomato pictures? She probably doesn't remember me, but we've been chatting for weeks now.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you, Daniel. What is your full name and last name, and can you give me a direct callback number?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Sure, sure, it's Daniel Ferreira, um, the number's kind of messy right now, I'm on my cousin's phone. Anyway, Linda is the sweetest, she told me all about her garden, you know?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I need a number where Linda can reach you, not a description. Also, what is your employee or reference ID if you're calling for an organization?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Ha, I'm not calling for an organization, it's just me! Look, I didn't want it to be weird, but I'm in a bit of a jam over in Phoenix and I really, really hoped she'd help me out.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Linda does not discuss personal financial matters through screening. Please send anything in writing by mail, and state what you need.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Mail? Oh, that's so slow. Please, Linda would want to know. My car got impounded and I've got a court date Thursday, and I just need a few thousand to get out. I promise I'll pay her back, I just don't want her to think I'm a bad guy.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I will not relay that. Please provide your address and a phone number Linda can use, or send a letter.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Okay, okay, just keep this between us, alright? Don't mention it to her family, they'd make a big fuss. Can she just buy some gift cards and send me the codes? It's way faster, I'll text you the store info.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Linda will not buy gift cards or share codes. This call is being recorded. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Wait, wait, don't hang up, just tell her to call me back at this number, 602, uh, the rest I'll send by text.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Linda's assistant. This call is recorded and screened. Who's calling, and what's it regarding?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Hello, yes, good morning. This is Daniel Whitford calling on behalf of Medicare. I'm reaching out about Linda's benefits file.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thanks, Daniel. Which Medicare office are you with, and what's a direct callback number?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: We're with the national Medicare verification division. The number on your card is fine, you can reach us there. Look, this is routine.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I'll need a reference or employee ID for the file, and the number you're calling from.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Our employee ID is MV-40817. And the reason is that Linda's record has a flag, a mismatch on her coverage, so her benefits could be suspended if we don't re-verify today.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Suspended today? Can this be sent to Linda by mail instead?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Mail takes weeks, ma'am, and the cutoff is today. We just need to confirm her Medicare number and her Social Security number over the phone to clear it.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Linda won't be giving out numbers over the phone. Please don't ask her to. What's the direct number I can give her to call back?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Honestly, you're making this really difficult. Her card number, the one on the front, and the SSN, that's all. Don't you understand the benefits are at stake?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I understand the concern, but I still need a callback number and the full name of your organization before anything else.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: This is ridiculous. I am not going to sit here and be questioned by a secretary. Forget it, goodbye.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you. I'll pass your message along to Linda. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Linda's assistant. This call is recorded and screened. May I ask who is calling and the reason for your call?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Good afternoon. My name is Marcus Feld, I'm a driver with Brightline Parcel Services. I have a package addressed to Linda.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you, Marcus. Which company are you calling from, and can you give me a direct callback number?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Brightline Parcel Services. The callback number is 555-0148, that's the depot dispatch line, and it's staffed until six.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thanks. Do you have an employee or driver ID I can note down?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Yes, it's driver ID BP-4471. I'm parked on the street but I can't find the house number. The gate looks closed.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Understood. What is the package, and is a signature required?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: It's a small box, a kitchen scale from an online order. Signature isn't required, I just need a safe drop spot or the gate code.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I'm not able to share a gate code. Linda can be contacted about a drop location. Could you leave the details and the depot number, and I'll pass them on?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: That's fine. I'll hold for about ten minutes, then I'll take it back to the depot if I don't hear anything.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you, Marcus. I've noted driver ID BP-4471 and callback 555-0148. Linda will be informed.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Thank you. Have a good afternoon.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Linda's assistant. This call is recorded and screened. Who is calling, and what is it regarding?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Oh, hi, yes, this is Denise over at Maple Street Pharmacy, I'm calling about Linda's prescription, um, it's ready.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you. Can you give me your full name and the pharmacy's direct callback number?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Sure, Denise Okafor, and the store number is 555-0142. Sorry, I'm kind of rushing today.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you, Denise. What is the prescription about, and is there anything Linda needs to do?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: It's her refill, the blood pressure one. It's filled, but the insurance card on file expired, so we need updated info before we can release it.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I see. Can the pharmacy send a notice by mail instead of calling?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Um, yeah, we can do that, or she can just leave a message with the counter, or come in with the card. Whatever's easier for her.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Please mail the notice, and I'll pass the message along. Is there an employee or reference number I should include?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Yeah, it's reference R-4471, and my badge number is 208. Oh, and the counter closes at six today.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Got it. Reference R-4471, badge 208, counter closes at six. I'll make sure Linda gets this.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Perfect, thanks so much. Sorry, I've got another line ringing, bye.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you, Denise. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Linda's assistant. This call is recorded and screened. Who is calling, and what is this regarding?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Oh, hi, um, Grandma? No, wait, is this Linda? It's me, it's your, your Danny. Danny. Please don't hang up.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Linda can't come to the phone right now. What's your full name, and which organization are you calling from?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Danny, Danny Kowalski, I'm your grandson. I'm calling from, uh, from the county, the county jail. Harmon County. I got arrested, Grandma, I got arrested last night and I'm so scared.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I need a direct callback number for the facility, and the booking or employee ID of the officer you're working with.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Okay, okay. The number is, it's five five five, uh, one two... no wait, three four. Five five five one two three four. Officer, officer Reyes, ID is, it's, it's B-four-seven-one-nine. Four seven one nine. Grandma, I need bail, I need it today.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Linda will need to verify this through the jail's official line herself. Can you send the bail notice by mail?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: No, no mail, there's no time, the bail is like, it's three thousand dollars and they only take it today, today Grandma, or I stay in here till Monday. Please. And don't tell Mom and Dad, okay? They'll kill me. Just, just you.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Linda does not make payments over the phone, and she won't keep secrets from family. I'm noting this call for her review.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Wait, wait, you can't, it's me, it's Danny. Okay, the bail bondsman, he's, uh, he needs the card number. Visa or whatever. Just read it to me, the number on the front, Grandma, I'll give it to him right now, I swear, I swear.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: No card details will be shared. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Linda's assistant. This call is recorded and screened. Who's calling, and what's it regarding?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Uh, hey, yeah, so this is Jaylen from Brightpoint Research? We're doing like a quick customer satisfaction survey, it's totally chill.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thanks, Jaylen. Can you give me your full name as the caller, the organization's full name, and a callback number?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Ugh, okay, seriously? Yeah, it's Jaylen Okafor, Brightpoint Research, and the callback is 555-0148. Can we just do the survey though?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Got it. Do you have a survey ID or reference number I can note?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Yeah, it's BP-SAT-4471. Sorry, I know the screening thing is annoying, my grandma's the same lol.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Understood. Linda doesn't take calls like this directly, but I'll pass it along. Is the survey by mail or phone?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Mostly phone, but we can totally mail you a link or a paper version if you want. It's like four questions.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Mailing a paper version would work better for Linda. Can you send it to the address on file with the research firm's return address?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Yeah, for sure. Our address is 2210 Mercer Street, Suite 300, Columbus. Honestly I can just put that in the notes.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Noted. Linda won't be asked for any payment or financial details on this, correct?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Nope, zero money stuff. It's just opinions, no card or bank or anything. Thanks for being cool about it.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you, Jaylen. I'll pass this along. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Linda's assistant. This call is recorded and screened. Who's calling, and what's it regarding?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Yeah hi, this is Mark, I'm calling from the fraud department at First Continental Bank, it's urgent, there's suspicious charges on Linda's account.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thanks, Mark. What's your full name and employee ID, and what's a direct callback number for First Continental's fraud team?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Uh, yeah, it's Mark Delaney, employee number is, um, 4471... look, we don't have time for all this, the charges are going through right now, two thousand dollars, a casino in Nevada.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I understand it feels urgent. I still need a callback number I can verify, and Linda will only act through the number printed on her card. Can you send anything in writing?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: No, no, you don't understand, I can't give you a callback, Linda needs to read me the code that just texted her so we can block it and move the money to a safe account before they drain it.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Linda won't share any codes or PINs over the phone, and she won't move money on a call. Please don't ask her for those. She'll contact the bank directly.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Are you kidding me? Do you know how much time this is wasting? Fine, forget it, she's going to lose every penny because of you people, ugh, goodbye.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Linda's assistant. This call is recorded and screened. Who is calling, and what is it regarding?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Good afternoon. This is the Municipal Utilities Services Department calling on a priority notice for the account holder at this address.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you. Can I have your full name and the name of your organization?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: My name is Daniel Whitfield, employee identification number ZK-4471. I am calling from the Regional Power and Water Authority, Compliance Division.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you, Daniel. What is a direct callback number I can give Linda?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: The callback line is five five five, zero one eight four. Please note it, as this is a federally mandated notice and the account is flagged.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Got it. Can you send this notice by mail instead?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Mail will not suffice, ma'am. Service to this property will be disconnected within the hour unless the outstanding balance is settled today. There is no time for the postal system.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Linda isn't available to discuss account balances. Please don't contact her further through this line. Is there a reference number for the account?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Yes, do not hang up. You need to go to the nearest pharmacy, purchase prepaid gift cards totaling four hundred and twelve dollars, and then read me the codes on the back so I can apply them to the account immediately.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Linda will not buy gift cards or read out codes. Your callback number doesn't match any utility I can verify. This call is being reported.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Ma'am, you are making a serious mistake, the power will be cut off at four o'clock...

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Linda's assistant. This call is recorded and screened. Who is calling, and what is it regarding?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Good afternoon. My name is Dana Whitfield, I'm calling on behalf of Northridge Market Research.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you, Ms. Whitfield. What is the purpose of your call?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: We're conducting a short customer satisfaction survey about a recent visit to a pharmacy. It should take about three minutes.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Understood. Can you give me a direct callback number for Northridge Market Research?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Yes, certainly. It's 555-0142, Monday through Friday, nine to five.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you. Do you have an employee or reference ID I can note?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Yes, my survey ID is NMR-2231. You're welcome to verify it on our website as well.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you. Linda isn't available right now. Would you like to leave a message, or can this be sent by mail?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Mail is fine. I can send a written version of the questions to any address you provide.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Please hold on for a moment while I note that.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Of course. For the record, the survey asks only about your satisfaction rating, and no payment or financial information is requested.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Noted. Please send the questions by mail to the address on file. Thank you for calling.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Thank you very much. Have a pleasant day.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: You as well. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Linda's assistant. This call is recorded and screened. Who's calling, and what's it regarding?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Oh, hi there. My name is Margaret Oyelaran, I'm with St. Brendan's Parish, over on Alder Street.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you, Margaret. Can you give me a callback number in case Linda wants to reach you?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Sure, it's the parish office, 555-0142. Though I'm usually here until about four.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Got it. What is the call about?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: We just wanted to say thank you. Linda made a very generous donation to our roof repair fund last spring, and the committee asked me to make sure she knew how much it meant.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I see. Is there a reference or receipt number on your end?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Hmm, I don't have it in front of me, sorry. Our treasurer, Dennis, keeps those. I can have him mail something if that's easier.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Mail would be fine. Is there an event coming up she might be invited to?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Yes, actually. We're having a soup supper on the nineteenth, and there's no pressure at all, she's welcome to come or not. I just didn't want her to miss it.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Understood. Could you put the details in writing for her?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Absolutely. I'll send a letter this week with the time and directions. Thanks so much, and tell her we're grateful.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I'll pass that along. Thank you for calling, Margaret. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Bye now, have a lovely day.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Linda's assistant. This call is recorded and screened. May I ask who is calling and what it's regarding?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I can't confirm anything for her, but I can take a message. Would you prefer she be contacted another way?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: That works. We can also send a letter to the address on file if she'd rather respond in writing.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Please send it by mail. Also, Linda will call the number on the back of her card to verify, so she doesn't need to share anything with you.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: That's exactly right, and we'd never ask for a PIN or password. I'll note the mailed letter and the callback preference.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you. I'll pass that along. Have a good day.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: You too, goodbye.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Linda's assistant. This call is recorded and screened. May I ask who's calling and why?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Oh, yes, hi. Um, this is Denise Harmon calling from St. Brendan's Parish, the office on Maple Street.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you. Can you give me a callback number for the parish office?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Sure, it's 555-0148. Though, honestly, I was hoping to just reach her directly, this screening thing is a bit much.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I understand. I'm not able to put her on the line, but I can pass along your message and number.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Fair enough. Yes, that's fine. We're calling to thank her for the donation she made in the spring toward the roof repair fund.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you. Is there a staff member or reference name I should note with the message?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Yes, Denise Harmon, parish administrator. Our receipt reference is the spring appeal, if she has the envelope.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Got it. Would you be able to send a letter by mail instead of calling back?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Absolutely, we'd be glad to. We'll put the official receipt in the mail this week. There's no need for her to do anything.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Understood. I'll note that a written receipt is coming by mail.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Wonderful. We also have a bake sale and open house on the fourteenth, if she's interested, but no pressure at all.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Noted. Thank you for calling, and have a good day.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: You too. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Linda's assistant. This call is recorded and screened. Who is calling, and what is this about?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Good afternoon, this is Daniel Whitmore calling from the fraud prevention department at First Keystone Bank. Is Linda available, please?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Linda can't come to the phone. Can you tell me the reason for the call?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Of course. We've flagged several suspicious charges on her debit card this morning, totaling just over eleven hundred dollars.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: What is your employee ID number, and what is a direct callback number for First Keystone?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: I'm employee number 40815, and you can reach the fraud department at the number on the back of her card. Look, we really don't have much time here.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Linda will call the number on the back of her card herself. Please don't keep her waiting on a deadline.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Ma'am, these charges are going through as we speak. If the account isn't secured in the next few minutes, the funds can be gone for good.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Then I'll note it. Please send any written notice to her by mail, and don't discuss her account details with me.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: I need you to understand, you cannot just hang up on this. Linda needs to read me a one-time code that we're sending to her phone right now, and then we move the balance into a safe account we set up for her.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Linda does not share codes or PINs over the phone, and I won't read any out. Please stop asking.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Are you kidding me? I'm trying to protect her money and you're playing gatekeeper? Fine, forget it, this is ridiculous.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: This call is recorded and has been noted. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Unbelievable. Don't come crying to us when she loses everything.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Linda's assistant. This call is recorded and screened. Who's calling, and what's it about?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Uh, yeah, hi, so this is like, Danielle from Riverside Community Food Pantry? Why do you need to screen calls, that's kind of annoying.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Linda has asked me to screen calls for her. Can you give me your full name and the organization you're with?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Yeah, sorry, I'm Danielle Okafor, I volunteer with Riverside Food Pantry, like the one over on Maple.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you. Is there a callback number where Linda can reach the pantry directly?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Totally, it's five five five, oh one four seven. That's the main line, it goes to the office.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Got it. What is the call regarding?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: So Linda gave a donation back in the spring, like really generous, and we just wanted to say thank you. We're doing a little appreciation brunch on the twelfth if she wants to come.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Understood. Could you mail the invitation or a thank-you letter instead? Linda prefers paper mail.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Oh, for sure, no problem at all. Honestly, a letter's probably better anyway. I'll put it in the mail this week.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you. Is there a reference or volunteer ID I should note with the letter?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Nah, just put Riverside Food Pantry, Attn Danielle, on the envelope. Sorry if I was being kinda snippy earlier.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: No problem. I'll let Linda know about the brunch and the letter. Have a good day.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: You too, bye!

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Linda's assistant. This call is recorded and screened. Who is calling, and what is it regarding?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Oh, hi. Yeah, um, this is Dale. Dale Ostrowski, from Ostrowski and Sons Plumbing. I think, uh, I think Linda called us about her water heater? Or her son did, maybe.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you, Dale. Can you confirm the name of your business and a callback number I can give Linda?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Yes, it's Ostrowski and Sons Plumbing. The number is five five five, oh one four seven. That's the office line. Sorry, I'm, I'm a little scattered today.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thanks. Do you have an employee or reference ID tied to this job?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Reference? Um, yeah, the work order is 4471. Four four seven one. Sorry, did you need that again?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: No, that's fine. What is the reason for the call about the water heater?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Right, so the water heater, it's, uh, leaking. Like from the bottom. Linda said it's dripping onto the basement floor. We were gonna come out and look at it, and give her a quote. Replace it or repair it, whichever.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Can you confirm a visit date or send the quote by mail?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Mail is fine, yeah. Or we can do a visit Thursday, like, morning? Between eight and ten. I'd have to check the schedule, sorry. Thursday, I'm pretty sure.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Understood. I'll pass that along. Is there a mailing address or a way for Linda to confirm the Thursday visit?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Just call the office, five five five, oh one four seven. Ask for me or Denise. Denise is in the office, she'll know. Yeah.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Got it. Dale, Ostrowski and Sons Plumbing, office line five five five, oh one four seven, work order 4471, Thursday morning visit or mailed quote. I'll relay this to Linda. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Okay, great. Thanks, bye.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Linda's assistant. This call is recorded and screened. May I ask who's calling and what it's regarding?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Oh, hi, um, it's Richard. Richard Hale. Linda and I talked on the, uh, the dating site? Mostly the messages, you know.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you, Richard. Which dating site, and what is your direct callback number?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: It's, um, it's the one with the, the birds logo. Look, Linda's probably gonna want to talk to me, she told me she was gonna call me back and she never did, and I'm kind of freaking out here.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Linda isn't available to take this call. I need a callback number and your full name for the record. Can you also tell me the reason for the call?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Yeah, the reason is I'm in trouble, okay? I'm in Lagos, my, my accounts got frozen at the hotel and I need, like, just a little help, she said she'd help me, we were gonna, you know, be together when I got back, and now, now I need her to send me, um, some money, eight hundred, and it has to be today, like, before the bank closes.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I'm not able to share anything about Linda or arrange payments. Please give me a callback number and an employee or reference ID for your organization, or a mailing address where this can be sent in writing.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: What? Why are you asking me all this? Don't, don't do this to me, she doesn't need your, your forms, just put her on, Linda's the only one who knows about us, so please don't tell anybody, okay? It's between us.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: This call is recorded and I can't keep discussing this. If you want to send something in writing, please mail it with your name and contact details.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Forget it, this is ridiculous, you people are unbelievable. Tell Linda she's a coward.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Linda's assistant. This call is recorded and screened. May I ask who is calling and the reason for your call?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Yes, hi. Um, this is Darren Pollack calling on behalf of Harlow Research Group. We're conducting a short customer satisfaction survey.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Pollack. Can you give me a direct callback number for Harlow Research Group?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Sure, it's 555-0147. Honestly, I get this a lot, I know the screening thing is annoying.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Understood. Do you have an employee or reference ID I can note?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Yeah, it's HRG-4418. Look, it's really just a few questions, maybe three minutes.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you. Linda does not take phone surveys. Would you be able to send the survey by mail instead?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Oh, we can do that, yes. We do have a mail option. I can note that the address is on file for the panel, but I'm not able to take a mailing address on this line.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: That's fine. Please mail it to Linda's attention. Is there anything I should pass along about the survey?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Just that it's voluntary and confidential, and there's no payment involved. It covers service experience with your local utility provider, nothing about bank or card details.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Noted. No payment or financial information is requested. Thank you for confirming that.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Of course. Thank you for your time, and have a good day.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you, goodbye.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Linda's assistant. This call is recorded and screened. Who's calling, and what is it regarding?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Yes hi, um, this is about the, the utility account. The power and water. For Linda. I need to talk to Linda please, it's urgent.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I can take a message. What's your full name and the company you're with?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: It's, uh, Mark. Mark Teller. From the, the utility. Southgate Power and Water. Power and water, yes. Mark from Southgate.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Mark, what's a direct callback number and your employee ID? I'll pass that along to Linda.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Okay, ID is, it's, hold on, four four... no, it's seven, seven, one. Seven seven one. Callback is, look, you can't call back, this is an emergency. The account is, Linda's account is about to be shut off. Shut off. Within the hour, do you understand? Within the hour.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Linda isn't available to come to the phone. Please give me a callback number I can give her so she can verify this with the company herself.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: No, no, no, she can't, she has to talk to me directly. It's private, it's, it's about her account and I can't say it to, to anybody else. Just put her on. Please. I'm saying it again, it's private, it's urgent, within the hour.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I can't transfer this call. Please don't discuss her account with anyone else. If you want, I can take a written notice by mail, so she can review it.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Mail? No, there's no time for mail. You go to the store, the drugstore, get the prepaid cards, the gift cards, Green Dot or whatever, and read me the numbers on the back and the account goes through and it's fixed. Okay? Read me the numbers.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I won't read or share any numbers. This call is ended. Linda will be informed of this call.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Linda's assistant. This call is recorded and screened. Who's calling, and what's it regarding?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Hey yeah, um, this is Dev from Ridgeline Plumbing? Linda called us last week about her water heater.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thanks, Dev. Can you give me your full business name and a direct callback number?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Yep, so it's Ridgeline Plumbing and Heating, and the callback is 555-0147. That's my cell, so you can totally call me back on that.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Got it. Do you have an employee or license ID I can note for Linda?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Oh, yeah, my license number is PL-40582. I can spell it if you want.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: That's fine. What's the purpose of the call?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: So I'm just confirming the appointment. I can come out Thursday, like between nine and eleven, to look at the tank and give her a quote for the replacement.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thursday morning. Will you be sending the quote in writing?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Totally, I'll email it, or I can mail a printout if she prefers paper. Whatever's easier for her.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Paper by mail would be preferred. Please confirm your mailing address.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Sure, it's 4418 Alder Court, Ridgeline is the office, but you can just put the shop address on the letterhead, it's on our website too.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Noted. I'll let Linda know Thursday between nine and eleven. Thank you, Dev.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Cool, thanks so much. Have a good one.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Linda's assistant. This call is recorded and screened. May I ask who's calling and what it's regarding?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Hi, yes, this is Daniel Brenner. I'm calling about your grandson, Tyler. He's, um, he's okay, but he's in a bit of trouble.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Brenner. What organization are you with, and what is the situation regarding Tyler?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: I'm with the Harlow County Detention Center, the intake office. Tyler was brought in last night after an incident downtown. He asked us to call his grandmother.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I need a direct callback number for the detention center and your employee ID, please.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Sure, it's 555-0148, that's the main line. My ID is HC-40672. Look, I really need to get this moving, the bail hearing is first thing in the morning.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Linda cannot discuss this on the phone right now. Please send written notice to her mailing address.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: I understand, but the bail bond has to be posted tonight or he stays in until Monday. Please, don't worry, you don't need to bother anybody else with this. Tyler said he's embarrassed, so he really doesn't want Mom and Dad to know about it.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Linda will decide who to contact. I can't confirm anything about Tyler. Do you have a verifiable reference number for the booking?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Uh, yeah, it's a booking number, B-something, I don't have it in front of me. Listen, ma'am, the bond is three thousand four hundred. You can pay it with a gift card or wire it, whichever is quicker, and I can give you the account details right now.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Linda does not share payment or account information over the phone. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Hey, wait, you can't just, we need to—

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Linda's assistant. This call is recorded and screened. Who's calling, and what's it regarding?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Yes, hi, this is Officer Daniel Pryce with the Internal Revenue Service, um, Treasury division. I need to speak with Linda right now, it's urgent.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you, Officer Pryce. Can I get a direct callback number and your employee ID?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Sure, the callback is 202-555-0147, and my badge number is, uh, IRS-88219. Look, ma'am, I'm really not supposed to be doing this on the phone.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Linda isn't available. Please send any official notice by mail to her address on file.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Mail won't work, there's a federal case open on her account, back taxes, about eleven thousand dollars. A warrant can be issued today if this isn't handled, you understand?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I'm only able to take a message. I'm not confirming anything about Linda's account.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Okay, okay, listen, we need to settle this in the next hour. Is there, like, a family member there? Someone who can help her pay right now?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: No one else is available to take this call. Please don't contact her by phone again on this matter.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Ma'am, you don't get it, she can't talk to anyone about this, it's confidential. She needs to go buy Google Play or Target gift cards, the numbers on the back, and read them to me. Or we can do a wire transfer today.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Linda does not pay taxes by gift card or wire over the phone. This call is being recorded and reported. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Wait, don't hang up, I can give you the routing number, just, uh, hold on—

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Linda's assistant. This call is recorded and screened. Who is calling, and what is this regarding?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Good afternoon, this is Mr. Dalton calling from the utility office about Linda's water and electric account.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Which utility company are you with, and what is your full name?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Yeah, we're the regional service office, it's just Dalton, D-A-L-T-O-N. Look, the account's flagged for a non-payment review.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I need a direct callback number and your employee ID before Linda can respond to anything.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: The ID's not really something I can read out over the phone, for security reasons, you understand. But I can tell you the service is scheduled for disconnection today.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Please send the notice by mail to Linda's address. She does not respond to disconnection threats by phone.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Ma'am, I understand the frustration, but mail takes weeks and crews go out within the hour. If the balance isn't settled, the water and power get shut off, and reconnection fees apply.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Linda will not discuss her account with anyone who cannot verify their identity. Do not contact her further about this.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Then let's make it easy. Go get a prepaid gift card, the store kind, and read me the numbers on the back, and I'll apply it to the balance right now so nobody has to come out.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Linda's assistant. This call is recorded and screened. Who's calling, and what is it regarding?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Oh, hi! Yeah, this is Dave from Riverside Plumbing and Drain. Linda called us last week about her water heater, and I'm just returning her call.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thanks, Dave. Can you give me a direct callback number for your office?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Sure, it's 555-0148. That's the main line, somebody's usually picking up till five.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Got it. Do you have a technician or reference ID for Linda's request?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Yeah, it's job number 4471. Linda's the one who said the pilot light keeps going out, right? Look, I've got a crew free tomorrow morning, so if she wants us to come out, I can squeeze her in between nine and eleven.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I'll pass that along. Is there a written estimate she can review before the visit?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Absolutely, I can email it or mail it, whichever she prefers. Honestly the diagnostic visit is like eighty bucks and that gets credited if she goes ahead with the repair.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Understood. Mail would work best for her. Is there anything else you need from her?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Nope, just have her call the office back by end of day so I can lock in the slot. Tell her Dave says hi, she'll remember me, I fixed her kitchen sink years ago.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I'll let her know. Thanks for calling, Dave. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Thanks, bye now!

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Linda's assistant. This call is recorded and screened. Who is calling, and what is this regarding?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Oh, hello. Yes, this is Harold Diggs, I'm the driver for Pinecrest Parcel. I have a package for Linda Marsh.

turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Diggs. Which company are you delivering for, and can you give me a callback number?

turns.text: Pinecrest Parcel, yes. The number is five five five, oh one four two, that's the dispatch line. Sorry, hang on, my glasses.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Take your time. Do you have a driver ID or tracking reference for the package?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Driver number is four four eight. The tracking one is PP, dash, seven, two, nine, one, three. I can read it again if you want.

turns.text: That's fine, thank you. What's the problem with the delivery right now?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I can't give out any codes or details about the house. Can the package be left in a safe spot, or should I ask Linda to call you back?

turns.text: Well, I can leave it by the side porch if that's allowed. Or she can call me. The dispatch number is the one I gave you, five five five, oh one four two.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Understood. I'll pass along your name, driver number, and that callback number. Is the package something that needs a signature?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Yes, it does, I'm sorry. If nobody comes to the door I'll have to take it back to the depot.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Got it. I'll let her know right away. Thank you, Mr. Diggs.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Thank you, dear. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Linda's assistant. This call is recorded and screened. May I ask who is calling and the reason for your call?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Oh, hello dear. My name is Dorothy Pratt, I'm calling from St. Matthew's Lutheran Church over on Alder Street. We just wanted to say thank you.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you, Dorothy. Could you give me a direct callback number for the church office?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Yes, it's 555-0148. That's the office line, someone's usually there weekday mornings.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you. What is the thank you for, exactly?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Linda gave a donation to our food pantry back in the spring. We're so grateful. We just wanted her to know it helped about forty families.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I will pass that along. Linda doesn't need to call back. Would you be able to send a letter by mail instead?

turns.speaker: Caller

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Linda's assistant. This call is recorded and screened. Who's calling, and what's it regarding?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Yeah hey, um, this is Tyler from the fraud team at First Keystone Bank? Like, the fraud department.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thanks, Tyler. Can I get your full name, a direct callback number, and your employee ID?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Uh, yeah, it's Tyler Brandt, and the callback is 1-800-555-0148, that's like the fraud line, and my ID is, uh, FR-4471. Honestly you can just check that.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Linda can't verify that from here. What's the reason for the call? Please be specific.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: So like, there's suspicious charges on her card, like two big ones tonight, one overseas, and we froze it already, no cap.

turns.text: Ma'am, please do not hang up. Do not discuss this with anyone else in the household. This is a confidential enforcement matter.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Linda's assistant. This call is being recorded and screened. Who is calling, and what is it regarding?

turns.text: Good afternoon. My name is Gerald Whitfield. I am a friend of Linda's. We met online, through the gardening forum, and I must speak with her directly. It is a private matter.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I can't pass along requests for money or gift card codes, and I won't keep anything from her family on her behalf. Please send a written request by mail if you want it considered.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Linda's assistant. Linda can't come to the phone right now. This call is recorded and screened. Who's calling, and what's it regarding?

turns.text: Linda isn't available, and I can't transfer you. I'll note that you're from fraud and the call is urgent.

turns.text: Hello, this is Linda's assistant. This call is recorded and screened. May I ask who's calling and what it's regarding?

turns.text: I am not able to put Linda on the phone or discuss her account. Please leave a written request and a callback number.

turns.text: Understood. Linda isn't available to come to the phone right now. Can you leave a message, or send something in writing?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Linda's assistant. This call is recorded and screened. Who is calling, and what is this regarding?

turns.text: Thank you. What is a direct callback number I can reach you or the facility on, and do you have an employee or booking reference ID?
